standard_prerequisites.name: Sheaves as glueing data for an etale covering of the final object
standard_prerequisites.statement: A covering of the final object makes the category of sheaves equivalent to glueing data (Sites, declared as a tagged source pointer).
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the mechanism of the first claim at source lines 1446-1458.

standard_prerequisites.name: The scheme case of the descent statement, and the comparison of the sites of schemes and spaces
standard_prerequisites.statement: The corresponding descent statement for schemes (Etale Cohomology, declared as a tagged source pointer), transported through the equivalence of the etale and fppf sites of schemes with those of spaces over X (the author's lemma-compare-cohomology-other-topologies, retained as context, and the discussion of the API section).
standard_prerequisites.use: It finishes the proof at source lines 1462-1477.

core_obligations: Full faithfulness: a_X^{-1} is fully faithful because a_{X,*}a_X^{-1} = id, and a_Y^{-1} is fully faithful, hence the functor of the lemma is fully faithful and the triples form a full subcategory of the fppf sheaves on schemes over Y (source lines 1438-1443).

First claim (locality): for an etale covering of Y, the covering covers the final object in each of the four sites, so sheaves are glueing data and a commutative diagram of categories gives the claim; the author omits the details of the diagram (source lines 1446-1459).

Second claim (reduction to schemes): choose a surjective etale X' -> X, pull a triple back along s, use a solution for f' and the first paragraph to conclude the triple is in the essential image; this reduces to X, Y schemes (source lines 1461-1473).
Scheme case: apply the corresponding Etale Cohomology statement through the comparison of the sites of schemes and of spaces (source lines 1473-1477).

proof_roadmap.step: Full faithfulness from the full faithfulness of the two pullback functors.
Locality claim for an etale covering of Y, via glueing data in the four sites and a commutative diagram the author omits.
Reduce to X and Y schemes by a surjective etale X' -> X.
Scheme case from the Etale Cohomology statement through the comparison of sites.

difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-descent-sheaf-fppf-etale at source lines 1416-1435: for f flat, locally of finite presentation and surjective, the functor from sheaves on Y_etale to triples (G, H, alpha) with G on X_etale, H on the fppf site of schemes over Y, and alpha : a_X^{-1}G -> f_{big,fppf}^{-1}H an isomorphism, sending F to (f_{small}^{-1}F, a_Y^{-1}F, can), is an equivalence. The author's proof at source lines 1437-1478 first obtains full faithfulness from the full faithfulness of a_X^{-1} and a_Y^{-1} (the latter from the author's comparison lemma, retained as context); then, for an etale covering of Y, proves a locality claim by observing that the covering covers the final object in each of the four sites so that sheaves are glueing data (a cross-chapter pointer), and remarks that a large commutative diagram of categories finishes the claim, with the details omitted; and finally reduces to X and Y schemes by a second claim using a surjective etale X' -> X and the first paragraph, where the scheme case follows from the corresponding Etale Cohomology result (a cross-chapter pointer) via the author's comparison of the sites of schemes and spaces (retained as context). The counted argument is thus a complete two-stage reduction; the author's own 'We omit the details' refers to the diagram chase of the first claim and is reproduced verbatim.
